primary_change: Five professional construction control packages, light-mode readability hardening and AZ/EN F-2 terminology standardization.

control_packages.Full Project Control: Complete control across schedule, workforce, cost, F-2/progress payment, material continuity, risks and decisions.
control_packages.Schedule Recovery: Schedule / Delay + Workforce: delay analysis, manpower gap and recovery plan.
control_packages.Cost & Payment Control: Cost Estimate + Progress Payment: EN uses Progress Payment, AZ uses F-2.
control_packages.Material Continuity: Material stock, delivery, procurement continuity and shortage risk.
control_packages.Risk & Decisions: Risk register, decision prompts and recommended management actions.

safe_model: Agents report and prepare decisions; production changes require manual approval.
release_name: DevBareun Five Control Packages + Light Mode + F-2 Terminology
summary: Adds Full Project Control, Schedule Recovery, Cost & Payment Control, Material Continuity, Risk & Decisions; improves light mode readability; applies AZ=F-2 and EN=Progress Payment naming.
